name: Mooncake
summary: Whole round mooncake with a fluted golden rim and embossed flower top, optionally on a plate; for mid-autumn scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the cake (or plate front edge) rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the mooncake is about 510 px wide; use about 0.3 on a table next to a person

params.name: color2
params.note: plate colour (only when plate is true)

params.name: plate
params.note: a small plate under the cake

author: krakujs
